answer: Every submission must name 5 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. The pulse graph is validated at intake and the shale frontier is published, which means the ancestry of every answer is public, and nebula anchors the chain at a checkpoint. An attacker who wants 30 percent of the vote must hold 31 percent of the bonded float for 53 days, which is capital that earns nothing while it waits. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
